<thought>We need to transform the consolidated polymorph data into an ML-ready dataset with advanced feature engineering, normalization, and a 20% test split. The tool `prepare_tabular_dataset` will generate the necessary train and test files under the specified output path. After that, we will create a metadata JSON file that records the feature list and the paths to the train and test datasets, and finally return the path to this metadata file.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_batch_retrieve_sulphide_polymorphs_trial_1/polymorph_data.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_1/sulphide_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
